subject: Following up on my application
body:
Hi,

I submitted my application for the Senior Backend Engineer role about two weeks ago and wanted to follow up to see if there are any updates on the status. I remain very interested in this opportunity and would love to hear back whenever you have a chance.

Thank you for your time.

subject: Interview Confirmation Request
body:
Hello,

I received your email yesterday about scheduling an interview for the Product Manager role. I'm available on Tuesday November 19th between 10am and 1pm, or Thursday November 21st any time after 2pm.

Please let me know which works best for the team. Looking forward to it!

subject: Question about compensation package
body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Thank you for moving me forward in the process! I wanted to ask about the compensation range for the Data Scientist role. Specifically, I'm curious about the base salary, any equity or stock options, and the annual bonus structure.

I want to make sure this aligns with my expectations before we continue. Could you share some details?

Best,
Sofia

subject: Submitting additional documents
body:
Hi,

As requested, I'm submitting my updated resume and professional references. I've attached:
- Updated CV (derek_chen_cv_2024.pdf)
- 3 professional references with contact info
- My portfolio link: https://derekchen.dev

Please let me know if you need anything else. Happy to provide further documentation.

Thanks,
Derek

subject: Withdrawing my application
body:
Hello,

I hope this message finds you well. I'm writing to let you know that I need to withdraw my application for the UX Designer role. I have accepted another offer and will be starting a new position soon.

Thank you so much for the opportunity and your time throughout the process. I truly appreciated it.

Kind regards,
Amara

subject: About the Engineering Manager role
body:
Hi there,

I saw the Engineering Manager position and have a few questions before I apply. Could you tell me more about:
1. The size of the team I'd be managing?
2. The tech stack the team primarily uses?
3. Whether this is an IC/Manager hybrid role or purely management?

This information would really help me decide if it's the right fit. Thank you!

subject: Visa sponsorship question
body:
Dear Recruiter,

I am currently on an F-1 OPT visa and will need H-1B sponsorship by April 2025. Before moving forward with the interview process, I wanted to confirm whether your company sponsors H-1B visas for the Machine Learning Engineer role.

If sponsorship is available, I'm very excited to continue. Please let me know.

Thank you,
Yuki

subject: Any update on my application status?
body:
Hi,

I'm just checking in again. I interviewed with the team three weeks ago for the Sales Lead role and haven't heard anything since. I've sent two emails that weren't replied to.

I'm still very interested, but the lack of communication is making it hard to plan. Can you give me any update at all?

Thanks,
Marcus

subject: Need to reschedule tomorrow's interview
body:
Hello,

I'm so sorry for the late notice, but a family emergency has come up and I'm unable to attend my interview tomorrow morning (November 12th at 9 AM). Would it be possible to reschedule for later this week or early next week?

I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and hope this can be accommodated.

Best,
Elena

subject: Background check authorization form
body:
Hi,

I received the offer letter and have a question about the background check authorization form. The form asks about international criminal records but doesn't specify which countries are checked.

Could you clarify what the background check covers, and if I need to obtain any documentation from my home country (Ghana)?

Thanks,
Kwame

subject: Relocation package question
body:
Dear Team,

I am very excited about the offer for the Senior Product Designer position in San Francisco! I'm currently based in Paris and would need to relocate.

Could you tell me more about the relocation package? Specifically, I'd like to know if it covers international moving costs, temporary housing, and any visa/work permit assistance.

Merci beaucoup,
Isabelle

subject: Completely unacceptable treatment
body:
I cannot believe how I have been treated throughout this process. I took TWO days off work to come in for interviews, prepared extensively for the technical assessment, and then received absolutely no feedback for over a month.

I finally got an automated rejection email with ZERO explanation. This is disrespectful and unprofessional. I have been in the industry for 15 years and have never encountered this level of disregard.

I expect a proper explanation and apology.

subject: Offer letter received - compensation question
body:
Hello,

Thank you for the offer! I've reviewed the offer letter and have a few questions:

1. The base salary offered is $95,000. Is there any flexibility given my 7 years of experience?
2. The equity vesting schedule mentions a 4-year cliff — is a 1-year cliff possible?
3. When does the signing bonus need to be repaid if I leave within 12 months?

I'm genuinely excited about this role and hope we can find an agreement.

Best,
Nadia

subject: Quick status check
body:
Hi,

Hope you're doing well! I just wanted to do a quick check on where things stand with my application for the Staff Engineer position. I had my final round interview last Thursday and am eagerly awaiting feedback.

Thanks!

subject: Transcript and certifications
body:
Hi,

I'm following up on the HR Coordinator position. I'd like to submit my educational transcripts and professional certifications (SHRM-CP) as part of my application.

Should I email them directly or upload through the portal? Also, do you need originals or copies?

Thank you,
Carmen

subject: Interview
body: Hi can you tell me when my interview is? I think it was scheduled but I didn't get a calendar invite or anything. Thanks

subject: Work permit - important question
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am a candidate for the Finance Analyst role. I am a Canadian citizen and would need a TN visa to work in the United States. This type of work permit is typically straightforward for accounting/finance professionals.

Is your company familiar with TN visa sponsorship? I would need this confirmed before accepting any offer.

Thank you,
Fatima

subject: Portfolio and writing samples
body:
Hello,

Please find my portfolio and writing samples attached for the Content Strategist role.

I've included:
- 3 long-form articles
- A content strategy deck
- SEO analysis samples

I'm attaching them as a zip file. Please let me know if you can't open the files and I'll resend in a different format.

Best,
Ethan

subject: Withdrawing — accepted competing offer
body:
Hi,

I hope this email finds you well. After careful consideration, I've decided to withdraw my application for the UX Researcher position. I've received and accepted an offer from another company that is better aligned with my current career goals.

I really enjoyed the conversations with your team and think you're building something great. I hope we have the chance to connect in the future.

Warm regards,
Zoe

subject: Bonjour - question about the role
body:
Hello, je m'appelle André and I wanted to ask about the DevOps Engineer role. What is the typical day-to-day like? Is it mostly infrastructure maintenance or is there greenfield work? Also, does the team use Kubernetes and Terraform, or is the stack different?

Merci!

subject: Still waiting — application from 5 weeks ago
body: I applied five weeks ago and have heard absolutely nothing. No confirmation email, no rejection, nothing. This is incredibly frustrating. At the very minimum, acknowledging that you received my application would be a basic courtesy. Very disappointed in the process.

subject: Reference letter and ID documents
body:
Dear Recruiter,

I've been asked to submit a reference letter and two forms of government-issued ID for the background check. I wanted to confirm:

1. Can I send these by email or do you need them through a secure portal?
2. Is a passport and driver's license sufficient?
3. How long does the background check typically take?

Thank you in advance.

Samuel

subject: Relocation + visa question (Stockholm to Austin)
body:
Hi,

I'm thrilled about the opportunity to join your team! I'm currently in Stockholm and would need to relocate to Austin, TX.

Two questions:
1. Does the company provide an E-3 visa sponsorship for Australian citizens? (I hold dual citizenship AU/SE)
2. Is there a relocation budget for international moves, and does it cover temporary accommodation?

Thank you so much!
Nina

subject: What happened with my application??
body: I have no idea what's going on. Last week I was told I would receive a decision by Friday. Friday came and went, nobody called, nobody emailed. Now it's Wednesday. I'm on the verge of pulling my application because this process has been an absolute mess. Please respond ASAP.

subject: Interview prep questions
body:
Hello,

I have my technical interview scheduled for next week and I'm wondering:
1. Will the interview be on Zoom or in-person?
2. How many interviewers should I expect?
3. Is there a specific coding language I should prepare for the live coding portion?

Thank you for any guidance!

subject: Referral question — friend referred me
body:
Hi,

My friend Tobi Adeyemi referred me for the Cloud Architect role. He mentioned there's a referral program. Could you confirm:
1. Has his referral been recorded against my application?
2. When does the referral bonus pay out?

I just want to make sure Tobi gets credit. He speaks very highly of the team!

Best,
Oluwaseun

subject: Offer accepted - when do I sign?
body:
Hi! I verbally accepted the offer on the call with James yesterday. When will I receive the formal offer letter to sign? I want to give notice to my current employer as soon as I have the paperwork.

Also, would it be possible to negotiate a start date of January 6th instead of December 30th?

Thanks!

subject: k
body: k

subject: Salary negotiation and start date + visa question
body:
Hi,

Thank you for the offer! I have several things I'd like to discuss:

1. The base salary of $110,000 — I was hoping for closer to $125,000 based on market data and my experience leading teams of 15+.
2. I'll need an O-1 visa sponsored, which my current employer also does. This is non-negotiable for me.
3. Can we discuss a signing bonus to offset my unvested equity at my current job?
4. I need a start date after December 20th to give 4 weeks notice.

I'm excited about the role and hope we can make this work!

Best,
Anjali

subject: Any update?
body: Hi, any update on the application? Thanks
